title: Co-Evolving LLM Coder and Unit Tester via Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Yinjie Wang, Ling Yang, Ye Tian, Ke Shen, Mengdi Wang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: CURE alternates one policy between coder and tester roles, using a code-by-test execution matrix and private gold-test anchors to train both capabilities and to rank code at test time.
CURE 用代码与单元测试的执行矩阵共同训练生成器和测试器，并在测试时用生成测试选择代码。
why: It makes the feedback lineage of code self-play unusually concrete while exposing the key boundary that no gold code does not mean no gold supervision: hidden tests still define coder correctness and tester rewards.
inclusion_reason: CURE exposes a code-RL construction recipe in which coder and tester rollouts, cross-execution outcomes, gold-test anchors, and alternating scalar rewards form an auditable co-evolution episode and later support Best-of-N selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code generation benefits from two capabilities that are usually optimized separately: producing a correct program and producing tests that can distinguish correct programs from plausible wrong ones. Existing unit-test fine-tuning methods often obtain supervision from ground-truth code, which limits use on tasks that have statements and tests but no trusted reference solution. CURE asks whether one LLM can improve as both coder and task-derived unit tester through reinforcement learning.

The relevant data object is an interaction episode, not just a final program. For one task, the policy samples code candidates and generated tests, executes every code against every test, executes code against private gold tests, and derives scalar rewards for both roles. The same policy is then updated alternately as coder and tester.

The paper's “without ground-truth code” boundary is important. CURE does not train from reference solution programs, but it does use ground-truth unit tests. Those private tests directly reward code candidates and define which sampled programs count as correct when estimating tester rewards. The method therefore reduces dependence on gold code; it is not free of gold supervision or external correctness anchors.

代码生成依赖两种通常被分开优化的能力：生成正确程序，以及生成能够区分正确程序与貌似合理错误程序的测试。既有单元测试微调方法往往从标准代码获得监督，因此难以直接用于只有题目与测试、却没有可信参考解答的任务。CURE 研究的是：能否通过强化学习，让同一个 LLM 同时提升 coder 和任务派生 unit tester 两种能力。

这里关键的数据对象不是最终程序，而是一段交互 episode。针对一个任务，策略采样多份代码候选和生成测试，将每份代码与每个测试交叉执行，再让代码运行私有 gold tests，并据此为两个角色计算标量奖励；随后，同一策略在 coder 与 tester 角色之间交替更新。

论文所说的“without ground-truth code”必须准确理解。CURE 不使用参考解答程序训练，但仍使用 ground-truth unit tests。私有 gold tests 直接为代码候选提供奖励，并在估计 tester 奖励时定义哪些采样程序属于正确程序。因此，该方法降低的是对 gold code 的依赖，而不是消除所有 gold supervision 或外部正确性锚点。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CURE turns code/test interaction into two coupled reward channels. Given a task, one shared policy produces 16 code rollouts and 16 task-derived unit-test rollouts. Cross-execution yields a binary code-by-test matrix. Additional private gold-test columns identify code candidates that pass all available gold tests.

The coder reward is straightforward: it increases with the number of private gold tests passed. The tester reward is not simply “does a correct program pass this test?” because that rule favors trivial tests. Instead, the paper derives an individual test reward from a reward-precision objective. A useful test should pass code candidates labeled correct by gold tests while rejecting candidates labeled incorrect; tests that reject a gold-test-passing candidate or accept many gold-test-failing candidates are penalized.

The policy alternates coder and tester updates, so improved code samples provide harder negative cases for the tester, while improved tests can support better selection among code candidates. For long-CoT Qwen3-4B, the tester reward is additionally transformed using response length to retain reward polarity while discouraging very long test-generation traces.

At inference, generated tests are reused across candidate programs: Best-of-N selects the program that passes the most generated tests. This test-time selector is downstream of the co-evolution training process and should be recorded separately from the training episode and from final gold-test evaluation.

CURE 把代码与测试的交互转化为两个耦合的奖励通道。对于一个任务，同一策略生成 16 个代码 rollout 和 16 个任务派生单元测试 rollout，交叉执行后形成二值的代码—测试矩阵；额外的私有 gold-test 列用于识别通过全部可用 gold tests 的代码候选。

Coder 奖励较直接：通过的私有 gold tests 越多，奖励越高。Tester 奖励不能简单定义为“正确程序是否通过该测试”，因为这种规则会鼓励无区分力的平凡测试。论文从 reward precision 目标推导逐测试奖励：有价值的测试应让被 gold tests 判为正确的代码通过，同时拒绝被判为错误的代码；若测试拒绝了通过 gold tests 的候选，或让大量未通过 gold tests 的候选通过，则受到惩罚。

策略交替执行 coder 和 tester 更新，因此更好的代码采样能为 tester 提供更困难的负例，而更好的测试又能支持更可靠的代码候选选择。对于 long-CoT 的 Qwen3-4B，方法还根据回答长度变换 tester 奖励，在保留奖励正负性的同时抑制过长的测试生成轨迹。

在推理阶段，生成测试可在多个候选程序之间复用：Best-of-N 选择通过最多生成测试的程序。这个测试时 selector 是共演化训练的下游用途，记录时应与训练 episode 以及最终 gold-test 评测分开。

title: Method
方法
html:
The released training source is CodeContests_train, currently 4,529 rows. A record contains the source dataset, problem statement, task identifier, stdio execution method, time limit, public example_input/example_output, and private test_input/test_output. The paper describes selecting roughly 4.5K CodeContests tasks of difficulty at most 2. Functional-format tasks in MBPP and parts of LiveBench and LiveCodeBench are converted to stdio for evaluation.

For every sampled task, the policy generates Python solutions and tests in a fixed text format. The tester must emit test input, expected output, and an explanation. With 16 code and 16 test rollouts, the generated cross-execution alone contains 256 outcomes per task. Private gold tests are then appended for code scoring and for the correct/incorrect partition used by the tester reward. A code is treated as correct in that estimator only if it passes all available gold tests; this predicate can be wrong when the test suite is incomplete.

The 7B and 14B runs start from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. Sampling uses temperature 1.0 and top-p 1.0. The paper reports learning rate 1e-6, KL coefficient 0.01, 350 optimization steps, and 8 A100 GPUs. The long-CoT variant starts from Qwen3-4B, uses temperature 0.8, trains for 50 steps, applies the response-length transformation, and truncates training responses beyond 8K tokens.

Updates use a clipped PPO/GRPO-style objective with normalized group rewards and KL regularization. Coder and tester updates are sequential within each iteration rather than separate fixed models. The current repository default configuration exposes sampling, execution, reward, and training modules, but its default total_steps is 120; reproducing the paper therefore requires changing defaults and pinning the exact commit/configuration.

Main Best-of-N evaluation samples 16 programs and 16 tests, then ranks programs by generated-test pass count. Final benchmark correctness is measured using gold/private tests, not the generated-test vote itself.

公开训练源为 CodeContests_train，当前包含 4,529 行。每条记录包含来源数据集、题目描述、任务标识、stdio 执行方式、时间限制、公开的 example_input/example_output，以及私有的 test_input/test_output。论文说明其选择约 4.5K 道难度不高于 2 的 CodeContests 任务。MBPP 以及部分 LiveBench、LiveCodeBench 的函数式任务会在评测时转换为 stdio 格式。

对于每个采样任务，策略按固定文本格式生成 Python 解答与测试。Tester 必须输出测试输入、期望输出和解释。16 个代码 rollout 与 16 个测试 rollout 的交叉执行本身就产生每任务 256 个结果；随后加入私有 gold tests，用于代码评分，并构造 tester 奖励所需的正确/错误代码划分。在该估计器中，只有通过全部可用 gold tests 的代码才被视为正确；当测试套件不完整时，这个判定可能出错。

7B 和 14B 实验分别从 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 开始，采样温度为 1.0、top-p 为 1.0。论文报告学习率 1e-6、KL 系数 0.01、350 个优化步骤和 8 张 A100。Long-CoT 变体从 Qwen3-4B 开始，温度为 0.8，训练 50 步，使用回答长度变换，并在训练时截断超过 8K token 的回答。

更新采用带标准化组奖励和 KL 正则的 PPO/GRPO 风格裁剪目标。每次迭代内依次更新 coder 与 tester，而不是训练两个固定模型。当前仓库默认配置公开了采样、执行、奖励和训练模块，但默认 total_steps 为 120；复现论文结果需要修改默认值，并固定确切提交与配置。

主要 Best-of-N 评测采样 16 个程序和 16 个测试，再按通过生成测试的数量排序程序。最终 benchmark 正确性由 gold/private tests 衡量，而不是直接把生成测试投票当作真值。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Artifact evidence is strong but uneven. The official repository releases training and evaluation code, the four-stage optimization pipeline, converted datasets, and ReasonFlux-Coder-4B/7B/14B weights. The public CodeContests_train dataset has 4,529 rows and an MIT dataset-card license. The repository can generate temporary rollout and result directories during a run, but it does not publish one immutable corpus containing every paper-run code trace, tester trace, execution matrix, reward, and failure.

Across LiveBench, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, CodeContests, and CodeForces, the paper reports average improvements over the corresponding base models of 37.8 percentage points in unit-test accuracy, 5.3 points in one-shot code accuracy, and 9.0 points in 16-code/16-test Best-of-N accuracy for the 7B and 14B models. The ablation finds that coder-only optimization does not improve tester accuracy, while the full derived tester reward outperforms a simplified “passes all correct codes” reward. This supports the claim that explicitly optimizing both roles matters under the studied setup.

The paper also applies ReasonFlux-Coder-4B as a tester for GPT-series coders and as a generated-test reward source for RL on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. These experiments show downstream utility within the reported pipelines. They do not establish that generated tests are universally correct, that the private test suites are complete, or that the co-evolution episodes form a high-quality reusable dataset.

For unit-test evaluation, CodeContests and MBPP use available reference code. For CodeForces, LiveBench, and LiveCodeBench, the paper uses QwQ-32B-generated programs retained after passing all gold tests as reference programs. Those references are operational proxies: passing finite tests does not prove semantic equivalence to a true solution.

公开工件证据较强，但完整性并不均衡。官方仓库发布了训练与评测代码、四阶段优化流程、转换后的数据集，以及 ReasonFlux-Coder-4B/7B/14B 权重。公开 CodeContests_train 数据集包含 4,529 行，数据卡声明 MIT 许可证。仓库运行时可以生成临时 rollout 和结果目录，但没有发布一个不可变语料，完整保留论文实验中的每条 coder 轨迹、tester 轨迹、执行矩阵、奖励与失败记录。

在 LiveBench、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、CodeContests 和 CodeForces 上，论文报告 7B 与 14B 模型相对各自基础模型的平均提升：单元测试准确率提高 37.8 个百分点，单次代码准确率提高 5.3 个百分点，16 代码/16 测试 Best-of-N 准确率提高 9.0 个百分点。消融实验显示，只优化 coder 不会提升 tester 准确率，而完整的推导式 tester 奖励优于简化的“通过所有正确代码”奖励。这支持了在所研究设置中显式优化两个角色的重要性。

论文还把 ReasonFlux-Coder-4B 用作 GPT 系列 coder 的 tester，并把其生成测试作为 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 强化学习的奖励来源。这些实验说明其在报告流程中的下游用途，但不能证明生成测试普遍正确、私有测试套件覆盖完整，或共演化 episode 已构成高质量的可复用数据集。

在单元测试评测中，CodeContests 和 MBPP 使用可用参考代码；对于 CodeForces、LiveBench 和 LiveCodeBench，论文使用 QwQ-32B 生成且通过全部 gold tests 的程序作为参考。此类参考是操作性代理：通过有限测试并不能证明程序在语义上等价于真实解答。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
CURE's main difference from fixed unit-test generation or fixed-verifier code RL is the coupled training object. One policy plays both roles, the code-by-test execution matrix supplies interaction evidence, gold tests anchor the code labels, and alternating updates change both sides of the feedback loop. The paper further derives the tester reward from reward precision rather than rewarding pass rate alone.

The method is also distinct from inference-only generated-test voting. Generated tests are trained to discriminate gold-test-passing and gold-test-failing sampled programs, then reused as a selection surface for Best-of-N and agentic coding. The long-CoT reward transformation adds a separate efficiency objective by penalizing excessive tester response length without intentionally reversing reward sign.

What is not new includes sampling multiple programs, executing unit tests, Best-of-N selection, PPO/GRPO-style updates, and using tests for debugging. The direction signal comes from connecting these components into a jointly changing coder/tester loop and exposing a concrete reward lineage.

The method should not be described as fully self-supervised co-evolution. Gold code is absent, but private gold tests remain an external anchor for both roles. That qualification is part of the novelty boundary, not merely a limitation.

CURE 与固定单元测试生成器或固定验证器代码强化学习的主要区别，在于其耦合训练对象。同一策略承担两个角色，代码—测试执行矩阵提供交互证据，gold tests 锚定代码标签，交替更新则让反馈回路的两侧同时变化。论文还从 reward precision 推导 tester 奖励，而不是只奖励测试的通过率。

该方法也不同于仅在推理阶段进行生成测试投票。生成测试先学习区分通过 gold tests 与未通过 gold tests 的采样程序，之后再作为 Best-of-N 和 agentic coding 的选择界面。Long-CoT 奖励变换另外加入效率目标，通过惩罚过长 tester 回答来缩短轨迹，同时尽量不反转原奖励的正负性。

其中并非新方法的组成包括多程序采样、单元测试执行、Best-of-N 选择、PPO/GRPO 风格更新，以及使用测试进行调试。其方向性价值来自把这些组件连接为 coder/tester 双方共同变化的回路，并明确给出奖励来源链条。

该方法不应被描述为完全自监督的共演化。虽然没有 gold code，但私有 gold tests 仍是两个角色共享的外部锚点。这个限定属于新意边界本身，而不只是一个附带局限。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Gold-test coverage is the primary validity boundary. CURE treats a sampled program that passes all available private tests as correct when computing tester rewards. A semantically wrong program that slips through an incomplete suite becomes a false positive: it receives coder reward and can cause good generated tests that reject it to be penalized. The paper does not report mutation-score, coverage, or false-correct audits for this labeling step.

Co-evolution creates non-stationary feedback. Because one policy generates both programs and tests, both roles may converge on shared formatting, input distributions, or weak cases. Gold tests constrain this loop, but do not prevent co-adaptation outside their coverage. Generated-test accuracy, reward precision, and final hidden-test accuracy must therefore remain separate measurements.

Execution introduces operational risk. The public schema records a time limit, but the exact isolation boundary, dependency image, nondeterminism handling, timeout policy, and failure taxonomy for the reported runs are not packaged as an immutable environment. A 16-by-16 matrix also requires 256 generated code-test executions per task before private tests, so environment failures or resource limits can systematically shape reward.

Release reproducibility is partial. The data, code, configurations, and weights are public, but the GitHub repository has no tagged release and no visible code license. The current default optimization configuration uses 120 steps rather than the 350 reported for the 7B/14B models. Seeds, exact split membership, complete paper-run rollouts, execution logs, and rejected or malformed samples are not provided as a fixed bundle.

The evaluation is concentrated on Python stdio programming. Function-style tasks are converted to stdio, and several evaluation reference programs are QwQ-32B outputs accepted by finite tests. Results may not transfer to repository-level engineering, multi-file builds, stateful services, flaky tests, or security-sensitive execution. Public release of fields named private tests improves reproducibility but removes their secrecy for future evaluation.

Finally, accuracy improvements are evidence about the trained models and selectors under stated budgets. They are not evidence by themselves that the released prompts, tests, rollouts, or verifier labels are high-quality training data.

Gold-test 覆盖率是首要有效性边界。CURE 在计算 tester 奖励时，把通过全部可用私有测试的采样程序视为正确程序。若语义错误程序因测试套件不完整而漏检，它就会成为假阳性：既获得 coder 奖励，也可能导致拒绝它的优质生成测试反而受罚。论文没有为这个标注步骤报告 mutation score、覆盖率或假正确审计。

共演化会产生非平稳反馈。由于同一策略同时生成程序和测试，两个角色可能共同收敛到特定格式、输入分布或弱测试情形。Gold tests 能约束该回路，却无法阻止其在覆盖范围之外共适应。因此，生成测试准确率、reward precision 与最终 hidden-test 准确率必须保持为不同测量。

执行环境还带来操作风险。公开数据模式记录时间限制，但论文实验所用的精确隔离边界、依赖镜像、非确定性处理、超时策略和失败分类没有被打包为不可变环境。16×16 矩阵在加入私有测试前，每个任务就需要 256 次生成代码—测试执行，因此环境失败或资源限制可能系统性改变奖励。

发布的可复现性仍不完整。数据、代码、配置和权重均已公开，但 GitHub 仓库没有带标签的 release，也没有可见的代码许可证。当前默认优化配置使用 120 步，而论文中的 7B/14B 模型报告 350 步。随机种子、确切划分成员、完整论文实验 rollout、执行日志，以及被拒绝或格式错误的样本并未作为固定 bundle 发布。

评测主要集中于 Python stdio 编程。函数式任务被转换为 stdio，且若干评测参考程序是通过有限测试筛选的 QwQ-32B 输出。结果未必能迁移到仓库级工程、多文件构建、有状态服务、flaky tests 或安全敏感执行。公开发布名为 private tests 的字段有助于复现，却也使其不再适合作为未来评测中的秘密测试。

最后，准确率提升是关于特定预算下训练模型与 selector 的证据，不能单独证明公开提示、测试、rollout 或验证器标签属于高质量训练数据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout_search_test_time_trace_data track, CURE provides a clear schema for a two-role executable trajectory. A reusable episode should preserve the task and source revision; public examples and private gold tests as separate fields; policy checkpoint; role; raw coder and tester prompts/responses; sampling seed and decoding settings; every code-test execution, stdout, stderr, timeout, and parser outcome; the full interaction matrix; the gold-test-derived code label; both scalar rewards; optimizer step; and final evaluation outcome.

This schema supports several uses. During training, it can study how verifier errors propagate through coupled policy updates. During test-time compute, it can compare code/test sampling allocations and Best-of-N selection under equal execution budgets. For reward research, it can compare direct gold-test coder rewards, derived tester discrimination rewards, and generated-test rewards used to train another model. Failed and contradictory episodes are especially valuable for audit and should not be discarded.

Reuse must keep three boundaries explicit. Training-private tests are hidden from the model prompt but are publicly downloadable in the release. Generated tests are selectors or rewards, not final ground truth. Final benchmark private tests evaluate the selected program and must not be backfilled as labels for intermediate rollouts unless the intended use is clearly marked as post-hoc analysis.

Before extending the recipe, pin the repository commit and environment, publish exact train/evaluation manifests, audit gold-test coverage with mutations or adversarial candidates, report reward false positives, and version the generated-test policy separately from the coder policy checkpoint even when both roles share parameters.

对于 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 轨道，CURE 提供了清晰的双角色可执行轨迹模式。可复用 episode 应保留：任务及来源版本；分开存储的公开样例与私有 gold tests；策略 checkpoint；角色；原始 coder/tester 提示和回答；采样 seed 与解码设置；每次代码—测试执行的 stdout、stderr、超时和解析结果；完整交互矩阵；由 gold tests 得到的代码标签；两个标量奖励；优化步骤；以及最终评测结果。

该模式支持多种用途。训练阶段可研究验证器错误如何通过耦合策略更新传播；测试时计算阶段可在相同执行预算下比较代码/测试采样分配和 Best-of-N 选择；奖励研究可比较直接的 gold-test coder 奖励、推导的 tester 区分奖励，以及用于训练另一模型的生成测试奖励。失败或相互矛盾的 episode 对审计尤其重要，不应被丢弃。

复用时必须明确三个边界。训练中的 private tests 对模型提示不可见，但在当前发布中可公开下载；生成测试属于 selector 或 reward，而不是最终真值；最终 benchmark private tests 用于评估被选程序，除非明确标记为事后分析，否则不应反向填充为中间 rollout 标签。

扩展该配方前，应固定仓库提交和执行环境，发布确切训练/评测清单，使用 mutation 或对抗候选审计 gold-test 覆盖率，报告奖励假阳性，并对生成测试策略与 coder 策略 checkpoint 分别做版本记录，即使两种角色共享参数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• “No ground-truth code” is accurate; “no ground truth” is not. Private gold tests anchor both coder and tester rewards.
  • Each training task produces 16 coder and 16 tester rollouts, a 16-by-16 generated-test execution matrix, and additional gold-test outcomes.
  • Coder reward, derived tester reward, generated-test Best-of-N score, and final private-test correctness are four different signals.
  • The public release includes 4,529 CodeContests training records, code, evaluation tooling, and model weights, but not a fixed complete corpus of paper-run rollout episodes.
  • Reported model gains and reward ablations support the method under its setup; they do not certify test coverage or rollout-data quality.

• “No ground-truth code”是准确的；“没有 ground truth”并不准确，因为私有 gold tests 同时锚定 coder 与 tester 奖励。
  • 每个训练任务产生 16 个 coder rollout、16 个 tester rollout、一个 16×16 的生成测试执行矩阵，以及额外的 gold-test 结果。
  • Coder 奖励、推导式 tester 奖励、生成测试 Best-of-N 分数和最终私有测试正确性是四种不同信号。
  • 公开发布包含 4,529 条 CodeContests 训练记录、代码、评测工具和模型权重，但不含固定且完整的论文实验 rollout episode 语料。
  • 模型增益与奖励消融支持论文设置下的方法有效性，但不能认证测试覆盖率或 rollout 数据质量。
